grammar.intro_en:
verb + -ing: enjoy, like, love, hate, mind, finish, keep, practise, avoid, can't stand, spend time
verb + to + verb: want, would like, decide, hope, plan, agree, offer, manage, refuse, afford, learn
after a preposition, use -ing: interested in learning, good at drawing, before going
grammar.intro_ar: في العربية نقول «أحب أن أسبح» و«أستمتع بالسباحة»، ولا توجد قاعدة ثابتة تساعدنا، لذلك يقول المتعلم I enjoy to swim ✗ أو I want going ✗. الحل: احفظ كل فعل مع النمط الذي يليه كأنهما كلمة واحدة: enjoy + ing و want + to. وبعد حروف الجر (in, at, about, of, before, after) يأتي الفعل دائمًا بـ ing: I'm interested in joining …

rows: They refused to drive at night.

notes: like / love / hate / prefer can take both: I like swimming. / I like to swim. But would like always takes to: I'd like to swim.
Negative: I decided not to go. · I enjoy not working on Fridays.

write_speak: Write & Speak — “My hobby”: write 80–100 words about a hobby you have or want to take up. Say when you started, why you enjoy it and what you'd like to do in the future. Use at least four verbs from the grammar table. Then talk about your hobby for one minute.
other: Example: My favourite hobby is photography. I started taking photos five years ago with my old phone. Now I have a small camera, but I can't afford to buy a professional one yet. I enjoy walking around old Cairo and taking pictures of people and buildings. I usually avoid going out at midday, because the light is too strong. Last year I decided to join a photography club in Zamalek, and I managed to win a small competition! In the future, I'd like to take photos of the White Desert, and I hope to have my own exhibition one day.
